thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — pushed a tiny rename + gofmt in PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2598|#2598>. Ran tests locally but GH Actions shows a linter failure, leaving it for review.
ci-bot: GH Actions · Lint failed on commit 7a1d2c3 — `pkg/server/handler.go:42:2: exported var should be Response, not resp` (go lint).
sam: looking now, thanks for the ping.
priya: quick q: why rename `resp` -> `Response`? Looks like a small internal var, might be overly noisy.
morgan: generally: short `resp` ok for local vars; `Response` should be used for exported types/fields. If this was just a local rename it might be unnecessary.
alex: Good point — it was an attempt to be consistent after a refactor but I agree it reads noisy. I can revert the rename and just run `gofmt -w` in a follow-up commit. Anyone object? @priya
jamie: :thumbsup: no objection, revert + gofmt sounds fine. Approve when CI green.
priya: SGTM. Could you also add a 1-line note in the PR body explaining the revert so release notes don't get noisy?
alex: Will do. Pushed follow-up commit that reverts the rename and runs gofmt. CI rerunning: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/123456789> — ping me if it still complains.
priya: saw the new commit, thanks.
ci-bot: GH Actions · Lint passed on commit 9b3f4e1.
jamie: approved. Merge when green + QA window.
alex: merged after minor wait window. Thanks all!
